## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the shoe with black stripes from the table and set it on the mat

Task description: Place the white shoe with black stripes on the left side of the table on the blue rectangular mat toward the front right, adjusting it to the target orientation.

Success criteria: Place the shoe near the center of the blue mat, sole-down along its long axis, with the toe pointing right and heel left as seen from the robot facing the table. The shoe must be released and both grippers open.

## Execution tips

- Grasp the outer shoe upper on both sides of the laces in front of the opening, with pads on intact solid surfaces and closure across its width. Avoid laces and the thin opening edge to reduce slipping.
- Set the opening slightly wider than the selected grasp area. Before closing, confirm that the fingers are actually on opposite sides of the shoe body, with clearance between the fingertips and table; avoid pressing only on the upper or hitting the table.
- If turning it, keep the sole off the table and leave room for the toe and heel to rotate. Avoid dragging on the table or sweeping into the small box behind it or the gold ornament on the right.
- Release only after the shoe sole is securely supported by the mat. Leave clearance from the upper as you withdraw to reduce tilting or shifting it with a fingertip.
